name: external-review-profiles
description: Pinned external review provider profile for Claude Bridge and Antigravity Bridge.

interface.longDescription: External Review Profiles is a parent/profile repository that pins Claude Bridge and Antigravity Bridge as external review providers. It does not auto-install nested plugins; install the provider plugins separately or run their submodule helpers directly. Select every provider explicitly. Each selected provider gets one review attempt bounded to five minutes (5m0s); deep mode, retries, extra passes, and additional reviewers require explicit opt-in. Program execution requires a separate explicit user request.
defaultPrompt: Use Claude Bridge for one review attempt of my local changes, bounded to 5m0s, without executing programs.
Use Antigravity Bridge for one review attempt of my local changes, bounded to 5m0s, without executing programs.
